notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/f73c7a433733ac9a1e54dc6a155247a36496a9c1.jpg[/img]

[h3]Dear CEOs![/h3]
Do your New Year Resolutions include sending a rocket with your name on it into space? Well then, now is a great time to get back to [i]Space Company Simulator[/i]! The new patch concentrates on fixing bugs reported by the community. 

You can check the full list of the changes below.

In addition, the game is now [b]30% off[/b]. Get Space Company Simulator by January 22 to become the best CEO in the space transportation industry. 

And if you like the changes, please consider dropping us a review or updating your previous one. They help us understand if we’re going in the right direction. Thanks!

[h3]Changelog:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the “Space Program Mars'' building wasn’t necessary to finish the game. What, did you really think it was that easy?
[*] Fixed a bug where players could enter the Mission Control Center while the administration window was open.
[*] Astronauts now have a unique picture. 
[*] Events from the lower calendar now disappear while a player skips turns. Like they should. Let’s keep the calendar in order.
[*] Fixed the placeholder amounts in Weekly Revenue and Weekly Installments in Loans.
[*] Decision emails now make you gain or lose money. Do you feel the pressure of being a CEO yet?
[*] Full UI elements added to the Test Center.
[*] Fixed the text under Company Motto in the main menu.
[*] Buying the perks for Small Rocket “Dog-9”, Small Rocket “Hound-7”, or Medium Rocket “Space Explorer” MR-1 now unlocks the blueprints correctly. Try it!
[*] Fixed a bug where the particle system wouldn’t turn off after a rocket’s launch.
[*] Added missing descriptions of construction conditions to the Building map.
[*] The game no longer freezes when players access the Assembly Room.
[*] UI symbols of the settings menu now appear after players change the language to Polish.
[*] Fixed the marking of the Small Launcher building.
[*] There are no longer visual graphical artifacts on the building mode icon.
[/list]
You can discuss the new changes and share your feedback with us in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/923970/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url] and on [url=https://discord.com/invite/CPUcUZc]Discord[/url]. 

Now let’s get ready for the lift off!

notes.title: New Update available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/72123fab563464ba2baeeb5341d99f05e455cdad.jpg[/img]

[h3]Dear Space CEOs![/h3]
We’re back with a new update and a sale! Get Space Company Simulator before November 12 and reach the stars with a [b]30% discount[/b] to lighten your load!

The new update features major some upgrades to overall performance, many bug fixes including the Cash Overflow bug, and a completely redesigned UI! A full list of changes can be found below.

We know it’s been a while, so we would like to thank you for your patience while we were working on this update and hope that you’ll enjoy all the improvements.

Please give the new Update a try and let us know what you think! Your feedback helps us more than you think.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/29ddc5421c52f627d5dc2534b6d953a32b13214b.jpg[/img]
[i]Contracts are waiting for you in the inbox, Boss![/i]

[h3]Main features:[/h3]
[list][*] Major performance improvements
[*] Implemented transition of render from HDRP (High Definition Render Pipeline) to URP (Universal Render Pipeline) in the Unity Engine
[*] Fixed variable overflow (including cash overflow)
[*] Reconfigured particle systems and shaders for URP in Rocket Launch
[*] Converted the space environment of the Solar system to URP render
[*] Improved post processing settings in the space environment of the Solar system
[*] Redesigned and implemented the left navigation menu inside buildings
[*] Reworked and integrated the windows of contracts
[*] Reworked the timeline bar
[*] Implemented the logic of scheduled launch dates on the timeline
[*] Implemented technologies’ colors indicating current status
[*] Implemented requirements for the construction of buildings
[*] Implemented descriptions of buildings’ functionality
[*] Reconfigured elements of visual effects: clouds, terrain, lightning, and more
[*] Reworked and integrated the UI of the inner block window in the building mode tree
[*] Reworked and integrated the UI of the building mode tree
[*] Reworked and integrated the UI of the perks tree for all departments
[*] Reworked and integrated the UI of the inner block windows for the HR, PR, Finance, and Production trees
[*] Reworked and integrated the UI of game events
[*] Reworked and integrated icons for events
[*] Improved and integrated the work of Events
[*] Implemented new UX logic for new art elements[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/62267eb9caf3a8b221bcdd06c4582ecc9d4b1d7a.jpg[/img]
[i]T - 3… 2… 1… Liftoff![/i]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed the issue with the build freezing when creating a new game after completing the construction of any building
[*] Fixed the issue with pictured buildings not being visible on the constructed building icons
[*] Fixed the issue with duplicating pop-up’s logic of "Human Resources 2" building
[*] Fixed the issue of an incorrect pop-up saying "Public relations 2" building after completing construction
[*] Fixed the issue with the titles "Medium depot" and "Big depot" disappearing after building the big depot
[*] Fixed the issue with incorrect pop-up of the "Medium depot" building after completing its construction  
[*] Fixed the issue with an incorrect image on the "Medium launcher" building pop-up
[*] Fixed the issue with the "Medium launcher" building icon being displayed incorrectly after completing construction 
[*] Fixed the issue with the "Medium launcher" building having an incorrect pop-up after completing construction
[*] Fixed the issue of the progress not being displayed in the pop-up of a building icon in building mode
[*] Fixed the issue of the missing "Mission Control" building pop-up menu 
[*] Fixed the issue with the change of day and night by skipping a turn
[*] Fixed the issue with the tree trunks not being displayed
[*] Fixed the issue with employee images being displayed too early when starting a new game
[*] Fixed the issue with green elements being reflected in the pop-up window of a building that hasn’t been built yet
[*] Fixed the issue of the space environment of the Solar system not having any texture
[*] Fixed the issue with the shader of foliage trees 
[*] Fixed more lighting issues
[*] And more![/list]

[h3]Known issues:[/h3]
[list][*] The menus and windows of buildings in the Events window overlap the icon of events on the timeline
[*] The percentage progression on the Research tree icons for the Science department is displayed incorrectly[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/e132391cb5deab4dd96a345d9e946c13fdbb182e.jpg[/img]
[i]The schedule is packed with events. It's going to be an interesting year![/i]

[h3]Feedback[/h3]
Once you give the new Update a try, let us know what you think! We’re especially curious to discover how much you like the new UI and how you feel about the game’s performance improvements. Share your impressions in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/923970/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url] and on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/CPUcUZc]Discord server[/url].

If you like the game and the new changes, please also consider dropping us a review on Steam. They help us a lot!

Stay on course and aim for the stars!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/f78ee14d2e5c14ea57377cf6b82a5f049b4dae02.jpg[/img]

[h3]Dear Space CEOs![/h3]The new Space Company Simulator update has been released on Steam. It introduces a brand new [b]Sandbox Assembly, Historical Events,[/b] and multiple fixes! You can find more information about the new features and a detailed changelog below.

[h2]Sandbox Assembly[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/8e98f96ad8aa585cd1c681f63ffaa13005e1db11.jpg[/img]

Running your own space company is not an easy job. Taking care of finances and planning can consume plenty of time. Have you ever wondered what it would be like to have [b]unlimited resources[/b] and just focus on [b]assembling rockets[/b]?

With the new Sandbox Assembly, you can experiment with various rocket setups. Choose any of the available blueprints and buy any components you want. When price is no longer an issue, you can get components of the highest rarity without consulting your financial advisors. With unlimited resources, you can launch an unlimited number of rockets!

You can enter this mode from the main menu (“Sandbox Assembly”). You will be directed straight to the assembly.

[h2]Historical Events[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/71c1302b29f5dd49d6a43ac538710ccc0daaae31.jpg[/img]

Space exploration events are among the most important in humankind’s history. We want to appreciate and celebrate them, so we added the Historical Events feature which introduces crucial milestones of space exploration. Special tooltips are now displayed after hovering over the star icon on the top navigation panel. The events do not affect the gameplay but serve as great reminders that you and your company can accomplish great things too.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]⚙ Features:[/h3][list][*] Added Sandbox Assembly (described above)
[*] Added Historical Events (described above)
[*] Added possibility to create a research chain - select and automate an order of research that will be performed one after another[/list]
[h3]🔧 Fixes:[/h3][list][*] Fixed windows problems after minimizing the game
[*] Fixed an issue with the Apple of My Eye perk freeze

[*] Fixed an issue with the Increased funding for HR department contract requirements
[*] Added minor changes to various contract descriptions

[*] Fixed an issue with ignoring events’ mail content and moving to the next turn
[*] Fixed an issue with components in the store incorrectly displayed as “in production” after clicking on the store tab
[*] Fix an issue with delta-v not resetting after leaving the assembly[/list]

[b]Thank you for your help[/b] in making this update happen! Please continue sharing your fantastic ideas and suggestions with us. We look forward to hearing from you on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/923970/discussions/]Steam[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/CPUcUZc]Discord[/url].

Also, if you’re satisfied with the changes, [b]please consider dropping us a review on Steam[/b]. They help other space explorers learn more about the game and give us a chance to hear from the players who know SCS best. 

[b]Cheers![/b]

notes.title: Build your own rocket!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/bea10fa6f8fd08a9db4d26ed60512ca7112385ce.jpg[/img]

Space Company Simulator will put you in charge of assembling new rockets. You will choose from a variety of components, including:
[list]
[*] Fuel tanks
[*] Engines
[*] Utility modules
[*] Grid fins
[*] Rocket struts
[*] Utility modules
[*] And more
[/list]
You start by selecting the rocket blueprint. In the example above, the Small Rocket “Wolf-3” has been chosen - a small, uncomplicated rocket, capable of carrying a limited cargo into the air. Its construction takes 13 turns by default.

By investing in the Component Market, a large selection of components becomes available for purchase. To enhance the rocket above, two components were purchased:
[list]
[*] [b]Small Prototype Engine “Contender” MK-01[/b] - a prototype low thrust engine that can be used with lightweight payloads only. Due to its nature, it is unlikely to be suitable for prolonged use.
[*] [b]Prototype Fuel Tank “Donkey” FT-1[/b] - a prototype liquid fuel tank, allowing for simple rocket tests and lifting a light object into the air. It can have a problem with ensuring the required amount of fuel to get out of the atmosphere. 
[*] [b]Prototype Cargo Bay CRB-01[/b] - a prototype version of the cargo hold, designed for use in small rockets. Its level of sophistication and performance leaves a lot of room for improvement, but it will be just right for testing.
[*] [b]Small Strut LDB-01[/b] - a lightweight version of the strut used to reinforce the rocket’s supporting structure. Its low bending strength is compensated for by its use in truss systems, and its weight allows it to be used effectively on small objects and rockets.
[*] [b]Small Grid Fins LS-1[/b] - thanks to the Grid Fins, this rocket is controllable during the landing sequence. This substandard version is not very advanced, but it is enough to bring our rockets back to the ground. In most cases.
[*] [b]HGA I[/b] - the HGA antenna generates an extremely strong signal that allows better communication with the base.
[*] [b]IVA Suit[/b] - a basic suit used inside spacecraft. Not suitable for spacewalks.
[/list]
After assembling its components, each rocket can be tested to determine the probability of a successful launch. Lastly, the rocket is assigned to a mission and awaits its start.

With that knowledge, you’re ready to build your first rocket and launch it into space!

notes.title: Failing to plan is planning to fail
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/8ce12ad636f5513f5fdb74e57858719ad131302a.jpg[/img]

In Space Company Simulator, the gameplay is based on turns. A single turn represents seven days of the company’s lifetime and there are four turns during each month. Each move can take you a long way, so you have to be sure it’s the direction you want to go!

Most of the in-game actions that influence the progress of your company take a certain amount of turns, including:
[list]
[*] Building a rocket
[*] Fulfilling a contract
[*] Taking out loans
[*] Testing components
[*] Researching new technologies
[/list]

It’s your task to carefully plan your actions. Some of them, such as researching technologies, can only be performed one at a time. Make sure to arrange the work with care to reach the best outcome and let your company prosper.

As in chess, if you don’t have a few moves planned at a time, you might find yourself with no way out. Prepare to have your strategic skills challenged!
